notes: Fresh, opaque faction camp panoramas. The generator returned 1672x941 RGB PNGs rather than the requested 768x432; originals are preserved, bundled locally and downsampled by the native Image renderer.

prompts.human:
Create a finished background asset for Cart & Crown, a portrait mobile medieval fantasy strategy game. One complete illustration, not a mockup, not a contact sheet. Asset: Greenkeep human campaign camp panorama.

FORMAT: wide 16:9 landscape, target 768 by 432 pixels. Opaque full-bleed image. Crisp premium 16-bit pixel art, drawn as if at 256 by 144 and enlarged in exact square pixel clusters. Restrained harmonious palette, intentional dark outlines and clustered shading, no smooth painterly brushwork, no photorealism, no depth of field, no blur. Readable large shapes at a 300 by 144 pixel on-screen crop.

SCENE: a hopeful small medieval frontier camp in a green valley at golden dawn. A handsome practical wooden covered supply wagon with cream canvas, two clearly visible wheels and small blue cloth accents is the main foreground subject on the left-center. A modest timber hall and palisade gate stand at the right-center, with a blue swallowtail banner, stacked barrels and warm amber lanterns. Two very small adult travelers in simple blue-accented cloaks stand near the wagon, facing into the camp; they must be secondary silhouettes. A gently curving dirt path connects wagon and gate. Rich grass, a few wildflowers, dark fir silhouettes framing the outer edges, distant rolling hills and a small stone keep on the horizon. Welcoming, adventurous, grounded steel/wood/blue cloth; no grand completed kingdom, no extravagant magic.

COMPOSITION: calm sky occupies the upper quarter. Put wagon, gate, banner and lanterns within the central 75% of image width and central 55% of image height; top and bottom will be slightly cropped for a shallow in-game banner. Foreground corners may contain grass/rocks but don't block the wagon. The image must be attractive with no overlaid text. NO text, letters, numbers, labels, logo, UI, frame, interface, border, crest inset, buttons or watermark.
prompts.elf:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished background asset for Cart & Crown, a portrait mobile fantasy strategy game. One complete illustration, not a mockup, not a contact sheet. Asset: Heartgrove Refuge, the Elven campaign camp panorama.
FORMAT: wide 16:9 landscape, target 768 by 432 pixels. Opaque full-bleed image. Crisp premium 16-bit pixel art, intentional square pixel clusters, dark outlines and clustered shading with a restrained harmonious palette. No smooth painterly brushwork, photorealism, blur, or depth of field. Large readable silhouettes suitable for a 300 by 144 pixel in-game banner.
SCENE: a tranquil hidden Elven refuge in an ancient woodland at early morning. Center-right stands a modest elegant spiritwood lodge built into the broad living roots of an ancient tree, carved wood arches and pointed leaf-shaped roofs, subtle moon-silver trim, muted green banners with a simple leaf motif and warm amber lanterns. At left-center, a graceful wooden caravan wagon has a curved cream-and-sage canvas canopy, clear wheels and supplies. A noble stag with readable branching antlers stands beside the wagon. Two tiny adult Elven travelers, slim cloaked silhouettes, stand on a gently curving moss-and-stone path. Silver-blue ward stones with soft restrained glints flank the path, tiny blue flowers and a shallow woodland stream near the lower edge. Layered tall forest trunks and dappled sunlight frame the scene; serene emerald, sage, deep teal shadows, pale golden rays. This is a vulnerable rebuilding refuge, not a giant palace. No human stone castle, no oversized mushrooms, no technicolor glow.
COMPOSITION: wagon, stag and lodge are each immediately recognizable. Keep those subjects inside central 75% width and central 55% height, with useful scene detail spread from left to right. Dark tree shapes frame the outer corners, light in the middle. Top and bottom can be slightly cropped by the shallow game banner. Antlers must not clip. No text, letters, numbers, title, labels, logos, UI, border, interface, inset crest, buttons or watermark.

SCENE: a proud, resilient Orc clan encampment sheltered in a rugged red-stone highland valley at sunset. Center-right is a modest broad timber-and-hide clan hall, rugged iron bands, carved bone details, tusk-shaped supports and rust-red cloth banners with a simple angular clan mark. A heavy practical wooden supply cart with rough red-brown hide canopy, iron-rimmed wheels and supply bundles stands left-center. Beside it rests a stocky dark grey warg with a very clear wolf-like snout, pointed ears and heavy paws, unmistakably a large wolf rather than a horse. Two small adult Orc travelers with broad green silhouettes and rust-colored cloaks stand on an ochre dirt path; secondary details, no closeup. A central stone-ringed campfire and two warm lanterns bring inviting amber light to the camp. Weathered stakes, boulders, hardy grasses and a few dark pines frame the outer edges. Distant mesas and broken ridgelines under a muted violet/copper sky. Protective home base, spirited and hospitable, not a burning ruin or villain lair. No battle, gore, lava or exaggerated evil skulls.
COMPOSITION: cart, warg, fire and hall sit within the central 75% of width and central 55% height. The cart on the left and hall on the right connect through a curved path. Keep cart wheels and wolf paws comfortably inside the lower crop-safe region. Dark framing at outer corners, warm focus through the middle. Top and bottom can be slightly cropped by a shallow in-game banner. No text, letters, numbers, title, labels, logos, UI, border, interface, inset crest, buttons or watermark.
